parameters.query: SELECT i.id AS internship_id, i.supervisor_id, e.id AS employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.company_email AS intern_email, sup.company_email AS supervisor_email FROM public.internships i JOIN public.employees e ON e.id = i.employee_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN public.employees sup ON sup.user_id = i.supervisor_id AND sup.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE i.status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.intern_daily_logs l WHERE l.internship_id = i.id AND l.log_date = CURRENT_DATE );
